children: John Ma, co-founder of digital-asset data analytics firm Artemis, said he plans to sell his Bitcoin holdings and concentrate his investments in artificial intelligence companies.

In a post on X on Nov. 21, Ma said he has invested 50% of his net worth in AI company Anthropic and plans to sell all of his existing holdings, including Bitcoin, to invest only in five AI-related companies.
Those five companies are Anthropic, Alphabet (Google), Meta, Nebius and Nvidia. Bitcoin and U.S. stock trading platform Robinhood will be excluded from his investment portfolio.
Ma wrote that the risk-reward profile of AI applications is highly attractive and that revenue and profit at those companies will continue to grow.

title: Artemis Co-Founder Says He’s Selling Bitcoin to Go All-In on Anthropic
